tasks.title: E31 in full from its design
tasks.brief: You are the only coder on epic E31 (Who helps). Implement it in full from its design docs/tdd/E31.md: every section, and every R, V and D of its acceptance matrix with a test, including end to end tests on the real stack. Build in this order: domain, application, adapters, api, user interface, and run your tests as you go. If an epic you depend on has no code yet, code against its port protocol and the kernel fakes (docs/SYSTEM.md section 10).
